source_semantics.intent: Navigate from the authenticated AI Center to the AI Usage & Cost workspace.
source_semantics.side_effects: Navigation only; no AI generation, provider call, WordPress call, persistence write, approval mutation, or usage mutation.

laravel_runtime.tenant_derivation: tenantUrl derives and URL-encodes the target solely from FrontendContext.tenant.slug
laravel_runtime.visibility_contract: the control renders only when tenant.view + ai.use + ai.viewUsage are all present

proofs: exact canonical operation identity and generator-backed ADAPTED state
active tenant slug is URL-encoded and no caller tenant target is accepted
control is hidden unless source and destination permissions are all present
real AI Center and AI Usage routes are exercised under the authenticated tenant
guest, permission and foreign-tenant paths fail closed
navigation leaves AI usage and approval persistence unchanged

terminality.basis: The real AI Center renders a tenant-derived permission-safe link to the existing guarded AI Usage workspace; focused frontend/backend proof covers tenant isolation, authorization and non-mutation.
